annotations.title: Make a quote for a buyer

description: 按报价工具的输入和卖方的条款，生成一份发给买方的报价单：quote 是结构化数据（https://chukoudan.com/schemas/quote/v1.json，只有价格和条款，带 digest 和汇率依据，买方可核对），text 是可直接发出的纯文本（语言按 language），internal 是卖方自己的成本、退税和利润，只给卖方看，绝不发给买方。本站不保存任何内容。 Make a quote for a buyer from the quote calculator’s inputs (pricing) and the seller’s terms (quote): `quote` is the quote as data (schema https://chukoudan.com/schemas/quote/v1.json; prices and terms only, with a digest and the dated rate it rests on, so the buyer can check it), `text` is the same quote as plain text ready to send, and `internal` holds the seller’s own cost, refund and profit: for the seller only, NEVER send it to the buyer. Leave pricing.fxRate out to use the day’s RMB central parity. Nothing is stored.

pricing.description: 报价工具（baojia）的输入；不填 fxRate 就用当天的人民币汇率中间价。 The inputs of the quote calculator (baojia); leave fxRate out to use the day’s RMB central parity.

domesticBasis.description: 国内费用按。可选值：total = 合计；perUnit = 每件 / Domestic costs are given. options: total = for the whole order; perUnit = per unit

freightBasis.description: 运费计价方式。可选值：container = 每柜；cbm = 每立方米；total = 合计 / Freight is charged. options: container = per container; cbm = per m³; total = for the whole order

fxPer.description: 汇率单位。可选值：1 = 每 1 外币；100 = 每 100 外币 / Rate quoted per. options: 1 = per 1 unit; 100 = per 100 units

marginBasis.description: 利润率按。可选值：quote = 报价；cost = 成本 / Margin on. options: quote = the quote; cost = cost

markup.description: 投保加成（%） / Insured at (% of CIF)

mode.description: 计算方向。可选值：forward = 正算：成本 → 报价；reverse = 反算：报价 → 利润 / Direction. options: forward = Quote from cost; reverse = Profit from a quote

port.description: 起运港（选填） / Port of loading (optional)

price.description: 含税采购单价（CNY） / Purchase price per unit, VAT included (CNY)

quotedPrice.description: 你的报价单价 / Your unit price

taxRate.description: 征税率（%） / VAT rate on the purchase (%)

term.description: 你报的术语。可选值：FOB = FOB；CFR = CFR；CIF = CIF / Your quote is on. options: FOB = FOB; CFR = CFR; CIF = CIF

unit.description: 数量单位。可选值：pcs = 件；sets = 套；cartons = 箱；kg = 千克 / Unit. options: pcs = pcs; sets = sets; cartons = cartons; kg = kg

quote.description: 报价单上的其他内容：卖方、买方、品名、术语、港口、有效期、付款方式、交货期。 What the quote says besides the prices: seller, buyer, goods, terms, ports, validity, payment, lead time.

name: make_quote

PlainValue.description: A figure, tagged so a reader knows how to write it: amounts and quantities are exact decimal strings, never floats.

places.description: How many decimal places the rounding rule keeps; pad to it, never round.

value.description: A token from a fixed list the tool exports; the words for it are the copy key `<tool>.code.<value>`.

Provenance.description: Where the figures in an answer come from. In every answer, errors included.

language.description: The language of the source lines.

license.description: The license as copy keys: which text applies. `status` was `draft` until the text was approved (2026-10-12) and is `approved` now.

notice.description: 本站非官方渠道的说明：引用本站数据时请和来源行一起转述。 / The site’s own line that it is not an official channel: pass it on with the source line when you quote us.

site.description: The site the data is published by.

source_line.description: 来源行：回复用户时请原样引用它，让读者知道数据出自哪里、有多新。 / The credit line to quote as it is when you answer: who the figures come from and how fresh they are (the newest publisher’s day among the datasets used, or the day the answer was made).

ProvenanceDataset.description: A dataset version an answer drew on. An origin the register does not let the site show is named nowhere.

origin.description: The origin’s id in the register; null when the site may not show it.

published_at.description: The publisher’s own date (and time, with its offset, when it gives one).

source.description: The publisher’s own source line, in the answer’s language; null when there is none to show.

source_url.description: The publisher’s page, only where the register lets the site link to it.

version.description: Its version, named after the publisher’s date.

QuoteDocument.description: One seller’s quote to one buyer: prices and terms only, never the seller’s costs. Each field’s description names its counterpart in OASIS UBL 2.4 Quotation. `digest` is sha256 of the canonical JSON (UTF-8, keys sorted, no spaces) of the document without `digest`; `basis.rate` names the dated exchange rate the prices rest on, which a buyer can check at https://chukoudan.com/v1/datasets/central-parity.

basis.description: The dated exchange rate the prices rest on, when the seller includes it, so a buyer can check it.

source.description: `central-parity`: the RMB central parity of `day`, from https://chukoudan.com/v1/datasets/central-parity; `given`: the seller’s own rate.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every price. UBL: cbc:PricingCurrencyCode.

digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of this document’s canonical JSON without `digest`: UTF-8, keys sorted, no spaces, non-ASCII characters written as themselves (Python: json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)).

issued.description: The day the quote is issued, YYYY-MM-DD. UBL: cbc:IssueDate.

items.description: The goods. One line in v1. UBL: cac:QuotationLine/cac:LineItem.

hs_code.description: The seller’s HS code, digits only. UBL: cac:Item/cac:CommodityClassification/cbc:ItemClassificationCode.

origin.description: Country of origin, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. UBL: cac:Item/cac:OriginCountry.

packing.description: How the goods are packed, as the seller says it.

unit.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code: the quantity’s unitCode in UBL.

lead_time_days.description: Days from order to shipment, a whole number.

number.description: The seller’s quote number. UBL: cbc:ID.

payment.description: Payment terms as the seller writes them (T/T, L/C at sight…). UBL: cac:PaymentTerms/cbc:Note.

prices.description: One price per term offered. UBL quotes one set of delivery terms per document; this lists several side by side.

commission_included.description: Whether the price includes the buying agent’s commission (含佣).

place.description: The named place: port of loading for FOB, port of destination for CFR and CIF.

total.description: unit_price × quantity, a decimal string in `currency`. UBL: cbc:LineExtensionAmount.

unit_price.description: A decimal string in `currency`. UBL: cac:Price/cbc:PriceAmount.

schema.description: This schema’s address, which names its version.

valid_until.description: The last day the quote holds. UBL: cac:ValidityPeriod/cbc:EndDate.

QuoteDocument.title: Quote (chukoudan.com, v1)

Step.description: One line of the worked example: `id` is the copy key of its sentence, `values` fill it in.

message.description: 这一步的一句话说明，数值已代入，用请求的语言。 / The step as one sentence in the language asked, its figures filled in. Absent when a sentence cannot be made whole.

Warning.description: Something a reader should know about a result; `code` is a copy key.

message.description: 这条提醒的一句话说明，数值已代入，用请求的语言：回复时请用它，不要自己编数字。 / The warning as one sentence in the language asked, its figures filled in: use it, do not make up figures. Absent when a sentence cannot be made whole.

next.description: For a hint: the slug of the tool it points to.

internal.description: The seller’s own figures (cost, refund, profit, margin, break-even): never send these to the buyer.
